title: Enterprise Architect
description:
Job Description- Enterprise Architect 
 Position Summary 
 As an Adobe Enterprise Architect, you will define and deliver enterprise scale digital 
 experience architectures that leverage Adobe Experience Cloud, AI/ML capabilities, and 
 modern cloud platforms. You will partner with senior business and technology leaders to 
 shape strategy, architecture roadmaps, and operating models that drive measurable customer 
 and business outcomes. 
 You will combine deep enterprise architecture expertise with AI, data, and cloud-native 
 experience to design future-ready solutions: from customer data foundations and decisioning 
 to personalized, omnichannel experiences. As a trusted advisor, you will guide clients through 
 digital, data, and AI transformation, ensuring alignment between business goals, technology 
 investments, and delivery teams. 
 Success in this role is measured by customer value and adoption, quality and feasibility of 
 architectures, clarity of roadmaps, impact on KPIs, and depth of trusted relationships rather 
 than billable hours alone. 
 The Opportunity 
 Digital is disrupting traditional business models and reshaping every stage of the customer 
 lifecycle. Leading organizations are turning to Adobe Experience Cloud and AI-powered 
 experiences to stay ahead. 
 Adobes Enterprise Architecture team is a dynamic group of senior consultants who: 
 
 
 ¢
 Partner with executives to define digital, data, and AI strategies. 
 Design integrated architectures that connect content, data, insights, and activation. 
 Help clients adopt cloud-native, API-first, and event-driven patterns on platforms such 
 as Adobe Experience Platform, Adobe Experience Cloud solutions, and public cloud 
 providers. 
 As an Enterprise Architect, you will use your knowledge of digital marketing technology, 
 AI/ML capabilities, and enterprise architecture to: 
 ¢
 ¢
 ¢
 Create strategic roadmaps for digital experience and AI innovation. 
 Lead clients as a subject matter expert. 
 Serve as a trusted advisor across business, data, and technology stakeholders. 
 What you'll Do 
 Shape digital, data, and AI strategy 
 ¢
 o
 Partner with executive and senior client stakeholders to define digital experience, 
 customer data, and AI/ML goals. 
 o
 Translate business vision into actionable multi-year architecture roadmaps 
 encompassing Adobe solutions, data/ML platforms, and cloud services. 
 
 
 
 o
 Identify key business drivers, KPIs, and value hypotheses to prioritize use cases 
 (e.g., personalization, journey orchestration, next-best action, marketing 
 optimization). 
 ¢
 Design enterprise and solution architectures 
 o
 o
 o
 Design end-to-end architectures across Adobe Experience Cloud and client 
 ecosystems. 
 Define AI- and data-centric architectures, including: Customer data platforms, 
 identity, and profile management. 
 Data ingestion, quality, governance, and activation patterns. Recommend future- 
 state technology architectures using cloud-native principles (API-first, 
 microservices, event-driven, serverless) across Azure, AWS, and/or other public 
 clouds. 
 o
 Define reference architectures and patterns for secure, scalable cloud 
 deployments. Zero-trust, identity, and access management. Observability and 
 reliability. 
 ¢
 Drive alignment and governance 
 o
 Ensure alignment between business strategies, enterprise architecture, and 
 delivery teams across marketing, product, data, and IT. 
 o
 Define governance, operating models, and ways of working (e.g., architecture 
 review processes, decision forums, standards) to support sustainable adoption of 
 Adobe capabilities. 
 o
 Act as a liaison between Adobe teams, client business owners, IT, data/analytics, 
 and external partners for the full lifecycle of the engagement. 
 ¢
 Communicate and evangelize 
 o
 o
 o
 Communicate architecture options, trade-offs, and recommendations to C-level 
 and senior leadership using clear narratives, visuals, and value framing. 
 Lead workshops, visioning sessions, and roadmap presentations that evangelize 
 AI and data driven digital experiences. 
 Advocate for the Enterprise Architecture function and your work within the larger 
 Adobe Consulting organization and with clients. 
 ¢
 Contribute to practice growth 
 o
 o
 o
 o
 Capture and codify reusable assets (reference architectures, patterns, templates, 
 accelerators). 
 Mentor other architects and consultants on enterprise, AI, and cloud architecture 
 best practices. 
 Support pre-sales activities (e.g., solutioning, estimations, proposals, executive 
 presentations) to position Adobe and EA services. 
 What you need to succeed 
 ¢
 ¢
 ¢
 proven record to develop enterprise architecture models. 
 Validated experience with architecture frameworks such as API, SOA, and TOGAF 
 Understanding & experience with public cloud architecture and services (Microsoft 
 Azure / Amazon AWS). 
 ¢
 Experience designing or integrating AI-powered customer experiences, including 
 working with LLM-based services and understanding core concepts such as prompt 
 design, RAG, and model evaluation strategies. 
 
 
 
 ¢
 ¢
 Ability to collaborate with data/ML teams to define AI solution patterns and 
 guardrails, including basic awareness of agentic workflows and tool using agents, and 
 how they impact reliability, observability, and governance in enterprise environments. 
 Experience from working with the Adobe Experience Cloud or at least one of its 
 solutions & Previous experience with other Digital Marketing platforms. (Good to 
 have). 
 ¢
 ¢
 Experience communicating across senior leadership. 
 Ability to intake client business vision and translate to technical solution and 
 architecture requirements. 
 ¢
 ¢
 ¢
 Clear written and verbal communication skills communicating deliverables, sharing 
 information, and leading meetings. 
 Ability to communicate and lead execution of architecture vision across multi- 
 functional technical and strategy teams. 
 Experience working with software engineers, data architects, application developers & 
 data scientists to plan out end-to-end solutions 
 ¢
 ¢
 Understanding the solutions and systems that support it. 
 Ability to communicate technical and business strategy optimally to audiences of 
 varying levels of experience, background, and seniority. 
 ¢
 Ability to travel a minimum of up to 50%. 
 At Adobe, you will be immersed in an exceptional work environment that is recognized 
 throughout the world on Best Companies lists. You will also be surrounded by colleagues who 
 are committed to helping each other grow through our unique Check-In approach where 
 ongoing feedback flows freely. 
 If youre looking to make an impact, Adobe's the place for you. Discover what our employees 
 are saying about their career experiences on the Adobe Life blog and explore the meaningful 
 benefits we offer.

Key Skills: Enterprise Architecture,Digital Transformation,Data Transformation,Solution Architecting,Martech,CRM,Salesforce,Data

Experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services and deployment. Experience with CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes. Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments, with knowledge of automated testing and mobile/backend testing frameworks.  What Were Looking For - Strong ownership and accountability for delivering quality mobile solutions. Attention to detail and focus on creating excellent user experiences.
